fieldValues.title: One hop is enough for evidence; structure and dependency need a bounded walk (five corpora measured)
fieldValues.summary: Measured 2026-10-30 over five corpora (srs-context, LiveWyer, srs-programme, muSrs, the spec): for each relation type, how many records are reached inbound at 1, 2 and 3 hops. Evidential relations (evidences, applies-to, answers, concerns, comments-on, ratifies) are flat: three hops reach nothing one hop did not. Structural and dependency relations (contains, precedes, depends-on, refines) keep growing: in the spec depends-on goes from 2.4 records on average at one hop to 8.1 at three (max 34); in muSrs from 1.7 to 4.4.
evidence: Readers' Select by relation rebuilds LiveWyer's problem dossiers with one inbound evidences hop, no container duplication
fieldValues.body: Suggests the answer to 'more than one hop?' depends on the relation type, not the query: a relation type could declare whether it is transitive (structural) or not (evidential), and a selection would walk only transitive types, bounded. That is a property of RelationTypeDefinition, not a query language.
